{{Top|leg}}
A '''derlac whistle''' was a [[Whistle/Legends|device]] that ranchers used to call [[derlac]] [[Cattle/Legends|cattle]]. Before inheriting a position as a [[Vigo/Legends|Vigo]] in [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] from his mother, [[Shal'mak]], the [[Kian'thar]] [[Kreet'ah]] spent time on his [[Kreet'ah's father|father's]] derlac farm on his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Shaum Hii/Legends|Shaum Hil]], corralling the cattle with a whistle as well as selling them for export.<ref name="SotES">''[[Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref>
